spans.s:
इरध् इर˚धते strive to gain;
 dat. inf. इर॑ध्यै.

इरस्य् इर˚स्य॑ति be angry or envious (w. dat.). —
अभि the same.

इ॑रा f. drink, refreshing draught;
 comfort, enjoyment.

इरा॑ f. drink, refreshing draught;
 comfort, enjoyment.

ईरण a. driving, agitating;
 m. = prec., n. pressing,
squeezing^1, uttering.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
